extDescription.message: Decode a JWT and inspect its payload from the right-click menu. Everything happens locally in your browser.

unsigned.message: No signature. This token is unsigned.

notVerifiedNote.message: The signature is not verified. This extension only reads the token.

algNoneNote.message: This token is not signed (alg: none). Its content can be modified by anyone.

encryptedText.message: The payload is encrypted and cannot be decoded without the key. Only the header is available.

errorEmpty.message: There is no text to decode.

errorNotJwt.message: The selected text doesn't look like a JSON Web Token.

errorSegments.message: A JWT has 3 segments separated by dots (5 for encrypted tokens). This one has $1.

errorTooLong.message: The selected token is too long to decode here.

errorHeader.message: Could not read the token header ($1).

errorPayload.message: Could not read the token payload ($1).

errorHint.message: Select only the token — the dot-separated parts — and try again.

reasonObject.message: it is not a JSON object

popupTagline.message: Decode a JWT without leaving your browser.

howToStep1.message: Select the token on the page.

howToStep3.message: The payload appears next to the selection.

privacyNote.message: Everything is decoded locally. No data is sent anywhere.

cannotOpenHere.message: JWT Decoder can't open a panel on this page. Click the toolbar icon and paste the token instead.
